new_foods.source: PROVISIONAL (nalt-names-11): Martinez Steele et al., J Nutr2023 Table1 Group1, "Natural, packaged, cut, chilled or frozen vegetables, fruits, potatoes, cassava, and other roots and tubers"; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10127522/ . The exact term hot peppers is not named: class-instance of the stated plain food class, supported independently by current USDA NALT Product22077, https://lod.nal.usda.gov/nalt/22077, checked2026-11-22, CC BY4.0 (identity, not NOVA). NALT has both peppers and spices ancestry. This row is the whole edible pepper product, not a generic spice extract or seasoning. Purdue FoodLink explicitly describes raw whole hot peppers and freezing/drying/grinding, https://www.extension.purdue.edu/foodlink/food.php?food=hot+pepper . USDA PACA commodity list separately names sweet and chili peppers in its fresh/frozen produce scope, https://www.ams.usda.gov/sites/default/files/media/CommoditiesCoveredbyPACA.pdf . These establish the physical vegetable identity, not an imported legal rule or a NOVA group. Oil-containing roasting recipes do not supply Group1 permission. Plain food or source-named minimal process only, no added substances. Grinding/roasting are named in the same paper, but an unspecified powder, extract, oil, isolate, nut butter or insufficiently specified preserved product gets no placement from this row. Not a strong marker. Current Table1 Group3 separately supports culinary additions: "These are relatively simple products manufactured essentially with the addition of salt or sugar or other substances of common culinary use, such as oil or vinegar, to unprocessed or minimally processed foods." Item-own salt/sugar/brine or explicit culinary additions use the existing Group3 guard; unknown additions remain unplaced. For nuts, the no-salt/no-sugar condition is item-scoped, never waived by a different item.

notes: Bush/pole names are also growth habits across distinct pod/seed foods, not forced to snap beans; old haricot/mungo/black-gram holds remain.
Existing chillies/pepper spice rows are not retargeted or upgraded to a standalone whole-vegetable answer.
Shea nut identity is distinct from extracted shea butter/fractions and oil. No fat-source admission, Codex or GSFA use. An incidental Codex search hit was not fetched or used.
NALT taxonomic ancestry supplies identity, not NOVA. Whole fresh/dry produce and edible seed kernel classes are independently placed by the NOVA source.

Rejected shorter chili-peppers alias because it rewrote the confirmed existing Hot Chili Peppers head to a duplicate hot modifier and lost a supported answer. Existing canonical route must stay intact. No guard change.

Dehydrated Vegetables is already supported by an existing class-level singular row/plural lookup, even though absent as an exact table name. Not counted as new, not an abstention hold; prior checkpoint non-admission wording did not mean removal.
